title: BITMAX launches crypto-asset lending
description: LVC Corporation announced that BITMAX would begin its crypto-asset lending service on 2020-10-07.
notes: Issuer-distributed launch authority. Launch campaign rates are not treated as verified realized returns.

title: LINE BITMAX service ends
description: LINE Xenesis ended the LINE BITMAX service on 2026-06-01 after announcing the shutdown on 2026-03-03; the official shutdown plan states that lending applications were stopped and existing lending contracts would be ended sequentially.
notes: The event date is the platform-wide shutdown date. Individual lending contracts may have ended earlier during the staged shutdown process.
